title: hemionitis horridula
intro: Hemionitis horridula, commonly known as the Horrid Horsetail Fern or simply Horsetail Fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Dryopteridaceae. It is a plant that has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory health. The therapeutic actions of Hemionitis horridula are attributed to its ability to act as an expectorant, helping to relieve coughs and congestion, and as an anti-inflammatory, reducing swelling and pain. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
